source_url_or_tool: Original and updated local production builds
Python Playwright with installed Chrome and axe-core 4.14.0
Actual sanitizeArticleContent and extractContentConversion functions via tsx
Local HTTP requests using browser, GPTBot, Googlebot and ClaudeBot user agents
scope: Twenty shorter section headings in three existing septic-care guides; full text enlargement and all nonheading source bytes preserved.
redaction: No secrets, customer data, production probes or analytics.
retention_class: Compact reports, command logs and hashes retained after temporary screenshots, scripts and build output are removed.

parser_preservation.scope: Exact planned source substitutions, frontmatter, parsed article body outside headings and closing CTA.

browser.preserved: Heading levels, IDs, font sizes, line heights, families and widths; all nonheading article DOM; title, description, canonical, JSON-LD, CTA, links and image contents. Only the reviewed existing-card permutation is allowed.

recommendations.decision: Accept the automatic reorder of the same three guides and same three services on the seasonal guide; exact rendered order, text and link/image multisets verified. All other recommendation results match baseline.

screenshots.scope: Before/after section views of all three guides, both themes, 1440px and 390px normal text plus 320px/200%.

limitations: Local deterministic evidence only; no production, ranking, indexing, lead-lift or Eve integration claim.
Existing technical statistics, compliance and credential claims in article bodies remain unchanged and were not revalidated.

The first scan read styles before enlargement settled; corrected scan asserts actual enlarged font size. Initial HTTP proof had 16 false failures from expecting an explicit robots tag and untrimmed source descriptions; corrected to compare unchanged rendered metadata.
Shared toolkit reservation failed on its known configured missing root; snapshots work and no shared configuration changed.
